relationships.subject: PPARγ
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrated that JLD alleviated acute gouty arthritis by upregulating PPARγ expression, which subsequently inhibited the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: Juanbi Lijieqing Decoction
relationships.evidence_quote: Both in vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that the Chinese medicine groups showed a significant reduction in TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 levels.

key_findings: Juanbi Lijieqing Decoction relieved swelling, pain and hyperuricemia in rat acute gouty arthritis, raising PPARγ and lowering TLR4/NF-κB and TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6.
Etoricoxib reduced cytokines without upregulating PPARγ.
